status_note: The filed part, top-n `min(x, n)`, fixed upstream in 30.30.0 ([#8888](https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/issues/8888), PR [#8896](https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/pull/8896)): writing it to a dialect without top-n warns. The other cases (`strftime`, `POSITIONAL`/`ASOF`, `TRY`) need a DataFusion dialect, which SQLGlot does not have, so there is nothing to report.
summary: DuckDB → DataFusion transpiling rewrites some functions with another meaning: `strftime`, top-n `min(x, n)`, `POSITIONAL`/`ASOF` joins, `TRY`. Only the top-n `min`/`max` part is filed (#8888) and re-checked; the other cases were not re-checked on 2026-11-04.
handling: Obsolete for sverify: the replay no longer transpiles (#264). File only if still present upstream.
